response.hostage_policy: Allocate four 2,500 USD collateral slots. Each new layer has fixed 2,500 USD entry notional, giving 1x leverage, and a fixed 4% initial stop: 100 USD planned price risk before costs. Maximum three simultaneous layers, with the fourth slot held in reserve; maximum two correlated crypto shorts. Freeze new entries if combined remaining stop risk plus estimated costs exceeds 330 USD. Never average down, widen stops, increase size after losses, or open trades solely to rescue a loser. Hold a losing layer only while its setup and original stop remain valid. Bank profits net of fees and funding as buffer. A profitable layer may be closed alongside a losing layer when their combined net result is positive, but this never overrides a stop. No buffer-funded leverage increases this week. After two stopped-out trades, pause new entries for 24 hours.
